verdict.rationale: Kimi's help center lists '定时任务' (scheduled tasks) among the assistant's general features, so the product documents its own scheduling capability. That is the only evidence, a single help-index mention, and it does not show whether tasks can repeat on a schedule or only run once at a set time. missing for 10: confirmation of recurring schedules rather than one-off timed runs, detailed docs on configuring schedules or workflows, scheduling in Kimi Code/CLI or the API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
